rows.name: NFL standings, 2026 division view
rows.covers: Official W-L-T, points for, points against, home/road/division records for all 32 clubs.
rows.limit: Does not publish game-by-game scores on this view; does not establish depth or availability.

rows.name: NFL injury report, 2026 Week 10
rows.covers: Player, position, injury text, practice status and game status for every listed player.
rows.limit: A mutable page with one observation held here; does not name a replacement, a depth rank or snaps; a club with no section is not a club without injuries.

rows.name: Club depth-chart pages (30 of 32 clubs)
rows.covers: Published order per club/unit/position, captured with a per-club hash and clock time.
rows.limit: Order is not assignment; 149 rank-1 slots name more than one player; two clubs publish no parseable chart.

rows.name: NFL 2026 schedule and scores
rows.covers: Fixture list, kickoff times in US Eastern, and final scores by week.
rows.limit: Kickoff times carry no zone; the schedule page is not a results archive with a version history.

rows.name: NFL rulebook, 2026 edition
rows.covers: Playing rules, including overtime and scoring, which set the settlement boundary for a market.
rows.limit: Does not define operator void/push rules or market-specific grading.

rows.name: NFL.com betting FAQ
rows.covers: States that odds shown on NFL properties are a partner widget.
rows.limit: Not a licensed odds feed and not a historical price archive.

rows.name: nflverse-data: schedules release
rows.covers: Game-level results, kickoff times, closing-style prices, rest, roof, surface, weather, QBs.
rows.limit: Community-maintained. The release does not say whether its prices are an open or a close and it carries no bookmaker identity. Digest verified; authority is NOT established.

rows.name: nflverse-data: snap counts release
rows.covers: Offensive, defensive and special-teams snap counts and percentages by player-game.
rows.limit: Community-maintained; measures playing time, not assignment or quality.

rows.name: nflverse-data: rosters release
rows.covers: Roster status per player, including reserve and inactive designations.
rows.limit: Community-maintained; status codes are not an official transaction log.

rows.name: nflverse-data: depth charts release
rows.covers: Historical weekly depth charts across seasons, used only as a cross-check.
rows.limit: Community-maintained and explicitly excluded from official-only gates.
